verses.en: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Mesia O le mea na vaaia e Isaia le atalii o Amota ia Iuta ma Ierusalema.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD'S house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
verses.sm: O aso e gata ai, e oo ina faatumauina ai o le mauga o i ai le fale o le ALII i tumutumu o atu mauga, e faamaualugaina foi e sili i mauga, Ona gasolo ane ai lea o nuu uma i ai.

verses.en: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
verses.sm: E o mai lava nuu e tele, ma latou faapea ane, O mai ia, tatou o ae ia i le mauga o le ALII, o le fale o le Atua o Iakopo; e aʻoaʻo mai foi o ia ia te i tatou i ona ala, ona tatou savavali ai lea i ona ala; aua e alu atu le tulafono ai Siona, o le afioga foi a le ALII ai Ierusalema.

verses.en: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.sm: E faamasino foi o ia i nuu ese, ma aoai atu i nuu e tele; ona latou tuʻi ai lea i a latou pelu e fai ma uamea o suotosina, o latou tao foi e fai ma polo e teu a“ vine; e le sii atu le pelu e le tasi nuu i le tasi nuu, latou te le toe aʻoaʻo foi i taua.

verses.en: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD.
verses.sm: Le aiga o Iakopo e, o mai ia ina tatou savavali i le malamalama o le Aw.

verses.en: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
verses.sm: Ua e lafoaiina lava lou nuu le aiga o Iakopo, aua ua tumu i latou i mea mai sasae, ma latou itea ao o le lagi faapei o Filisitia, ua latou osi feagaiga foi ma le fanau a tagata ese.

verses.en: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
verses.sm: Ua tumu foi lo latou nuu i ario ma auro, e le masino foi o latou oloa. Ua tumu foi lo latou nuu i solofanua, e le masino lava o latou kariota.

verses.en: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
verses.sm: Ua tumu foi lo latou nuu i tupua; ua latou ifo i galuega a o latou lima, o mea lava na faia i o latou tamatemai lima.

verses.en: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
verses.sm: Ua lafotuina le tagata nuu, ua faamaulalo foi le alii; e te le faamagaloina foi i latou.

verses.en: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.
verses.sm: to Alu ia i totonu o le papa, ina lafi ia i le eleele, ona o le matautia o le Awt, ma lona mamalu silisili.

verses.en: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.sm: E faarnaulaloina mata faasiasia o tagata nuu; e faamaulaloina foi le faamaualuga o alii; na o le ALII lava e viia i lea aso.

verses.en: For the day of the LORD of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
verses.sm: Auā o le aso o le ALII o ‘au, e oo atu lea i e faasiasia ma e faamaualuga uma lava, atoa foi ma e o faafefeteina uma; Ona faamaulaloina ai lea.

verses.en: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
verses.sm: E oo i arasi uma ua uumi ma le maualuluga o Lepanona; e oo foi i aluna uma o Vasana;

verses.en: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
verses.sm: e 00 i atu mauga maualuluga uma; e 00 foi i mauga tetele uma;

verses.en: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
verses.sm: e 00 i ‘olo maualuluga uma; e oo foi i pa uma e 12 aea;

verses.en: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
verses.sm: e oo i vaa uma o Tasesa; e oo foi i mea matagofie uma.

verses.en: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.sm: E faamaulaloina lava le faasiasia O tagata nuu; e faamaulaloina foi le faamaualuga o alii; na o le An lava e yna i lea aso.

verses.en: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
verses.sm: E matuá mavae lava tupua.

verses.en: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.sm: Latou te ulu atu foi i ana o papa, ma lua o le eleele, ona o le matautia o le ALII ma lona mamalu silisili, pe a tulai o ia e luluina le laueleele.

verses.en: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
verses.sm: O lea aso e lafoai atu ai e tagata a latou tupua ario ma a latou tupua auro, na latou faia mo i latou e ifo i ai, e lafoaiina lava i afora ma pe‘a.

verses.en: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.sm: Ina ia latou o atu i inavaevae O papa, atoa ma va i papz, ona o le matautia o le ALII ma lona mamalu silisili. pe a tulai o ia 2 luluina le laueleele.

verses.en: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?
verses.sm: O outou na, soia le faatuatua i tagata, o i ai lona mānava i ona pogaiisu; aua se a le mea e manatua ai o ia?
